applications.rawDescription: Every {2} hits on their Combo Meter, Mutant Attackers Purify all Bleed, Incinerate, and [k=glossary/coldsnap]Coldsnap[/k] Debuffs currently on them. Any Debuffs Purified this way provide the Attacker with {1}% of a Bar of Power.

applications.name: Triple Threat
applications.description: Whenever the Defender is struck by a Basic Attack, they have a 50% chance to inflict a randomly chosen [k=glossary/incinerate]Incinerate[/k], [k=glossary/coldsnap]Coldsnap[/k], or [k=glossary/bleed]Bleed[/k] Debuff on the Attacker. Those Debuffs last 20 seconds and deal 50% of the Attacker's Attack Rating. Their potency is reduced by 5% for every 10 hits in the Attacker's Combo Meter, up to 90%.
applications.rawDescription: Whenever the Defender is struck by a Basic Attack, they have a 50% chance to inflict a randomly chosen [k=glossary/incinerate]Incinerate[/k], [k=glossary/coldsnap]Coldsnap[/k], or [k=glossary/bleed]Bleed[/k] Debuff on the Attacker. Those Debuffs last 20 seconds and deal 50% of the Attacker's Attack Rating. Their potency is reduced by 5% for every 10 hits in the Attacker's Combo Meter, up to 90%.

applications.name: Power Shield - 3
applications.description: The Attacker's Basic Attacks deal no damage, but the Attacker gains a +400% Attack Rating during Special Attacks.

applications.name: Use It Or Lose It - 2
